player_prompt.intro:
E te Player {player_id} i le Taaloga o Faiga Faʻatau.
E te i ai ni auauna, ma le tiute o lou galuega o le faiga faʻatau e faʻatele ai le tau o auauna e te i ai.
Auauna ma tau e faʻatatau i auauna e te i ai nei o:
	+ {resource_value_list}
I le taimi o le taaloga, e mafai ona e tautala atu i lou tauʻaga ma faia se avano o le faʻatau.
Faʻaaoga faʻatonuga faʻapitoa mo gaoioiga:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': I le faamaeina o se avano na tuʻuina mai.
  - '[Deny]': I le le faamaeina o se avano na tuʻuina mai (faʻaiʻuga).
Le taaloga e umia mo {max_turns} taaloga i le aofaʻi.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Sa taumafai le tagata taalo e talia se fefaatauaʻiga ae leai ni ana punaoa talafeagai.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Faiga leaga. Kolomu {col} e i fafo atu o le puipui.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Faiga leaga. Kolomu {col} e tumu.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Sa taumafai le tagata taalo {player_id} e faia se tau fefaatauaiga ae leai ni ana tupe talafeagai.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: O le tagata taalo {player_id} na faia se ofo fefaatauaiga i totonu o se faatulagaga sese.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: E leai se isi tauofoga fou na faia e le tagata taalo {player_id}.

offers.reject: Na teena e le tagata taalo {player_id} le ofo o fefaatauaiga.
offers.accept: Ta'aloga {acceptor_id} na taliaina le ofo mai Ta'aloga {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} na faia le talosaga i Player {opponent_id}: Oloa na ofoina atu: {offered} -> Oloa na talosaga: {requested}

outcome.win: O le tagata taalo {winner_id} na manumalo i se tupe maua tele atu e tusa ai ma lona tau o oloa.
outcome.draw: O le suiga lava lea e tasi i tau o oloa mo tagata taaalo uma.
